title: TTR/49/2008 of COMMISSIONER COMMERCIAL TAX, UTTARAKHAND, DUN Vs M/S SAGAR ENTERPRISES, NAZIMABAD

paras.text:
TTR No. 49 of 2008
Hon'ble J.S. Khehar, C.J.
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Sudhir Kumar, Advocate for the revision
petitioner.
A perusal of the office report reveals, that the
respondent is unserved. In a connected matter (bearing TTR
No. 48 of 2008), Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate,
represented the respondent. We, therefore, direct that the
respondent be served through Mr. Ramji Srivastava,
Advocate.
Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate, on our asking,
accepts notice on behalf of the respondent.
Learned counsel for the respondent seeks an
adjournment so as to enable him to obtain instructions in the
matter.
Prayer is allowed.
List again on 16th June, 2010.
